rules.limitations: Use the complete native heat exchanger of the same 160 kWe Jakobsberg cogeneration installation per signed unit, factor +1. The source name/product and product-information text say heat pump, but the plant description and its two 590 kg steel inputs match the native heat-exchanger component, not the shared cogeneration components. This is an explicit interpretation of inconsistent source metadata, not a generic heat-pump proxy. Retain native steel delivery, 59 tkm road and 708 tkm rail, 1.42 m3 effluent treatment and water flows: the source has the same steel masses and total effluent but different transport and water-return coverage. No capacity, lifetime, efficiency or operational-energy scaling, extra plant components or avoided-product credit. Upstream production, allocation, transport, water balance, geography and vintage remain differences with unquantified score effects; no inventory or LCIA equality is claimed. Approve only inspected cut-off 3.8–3.12; no inferred older, patch, reverse or cross-system-model scope.
